ersättande grupper: a replacing group planning less than the target leaves its pupils short of their own, listed with it as their only Svenska/SvA source

halvklass: hemkunskap swapped with slöjd — 6A's slöjd 2 × 25 and each half's slöjd in the term it reads no hemkunskap, which 6A has no post in, mirrored by the other half in one week, are one planning, not double: 50 + 34 and 50 + 36, both on the target of 80
halvklass: the same swap with 6A's slöjd cut to 2 × 20 — the sum is the pupil's figure: 74 and 76 of 80, each pupil under on their own, from 6A and their half, and not double planned
halvklass: 6A's hemkunskap put back after the swap — each pupil is double planned in hemkunskap and in slöjd, since the half's hemkunskap is no longer a subject the class has none of
halvklass: 6A's hemkunskap kept for the autumn beside the swap — a dated class post is the class's too: double planned in hemkunskap and in slöjd
halvklass: a second slöjd post on 6A:1 beside the swap, in March and April — the half's slöjd is not the swap's one post, so its pupil is double planned
halvklass: 6A's hemkunskap put back after a split in turn — each pupil reads it from 6A all year and from their half for half the autumn, double planned at 65 and 68 of 30

halvklass: the same beside #215's slöjd swap of textilslöjd and trä- och metallslöjd — 6A:1's hemkunskap meets no day of its trä, which 6A has none of, but nothing mirrors it in that week: double planned at 65 and 68 of 30
halvklass: hemkunskap in turn over the autumn and teknik over the spring in one week, and 6A's hemkunskap put back — the other half reads no hemkunskap in the half's teknik weeks: double planned
halvklass: the swap and a half's matematik on top of the class's, in the spring or in the autumn — the half's hemkunskap is the slöjd's partner, not the matematik's: double planned in matematik only
halvklass: the other half does not read the two the other way round — 6N:2 reads no slöjd, 6P:2 no hemkunskap in 6P:1's slöjd spring: double planned
halvklass: the swap with the half's slöjd in another week than its hemkunskap — more lessons, shorter lessons, lessons of two lengths, odd weeks: double planned
halvklass: a half's dated post with no swap beside it is double planned — slöjd dated with the year's own ends, slöjd from the year's second week, matematik in the spring
halvklass: the swap mirrored and in one week, but over periods that meet — an undated slöjd, four weeks in common, one day in common: double planned

halvklass: the swap's shape reached some other way is double planned — both halves at once, another class's half, two halves without the class, a teaching group with a half's posts — while 6H's pupil in one half is the swap
halvklass: a teaching group on top of the class's matematik is still double planned, all year or dated to the spring
halvklass: the alternatives as before — a half's dated Spanska with a Tyska group is two språkval, and the class's Svenska with its half's Svenska in the Spanska spring is no swap, double planned
